description: Change one or more seller preferences for one marketplace (Account API v2 setUserPreferences, HTTP PATCH): include only the preferences to change under preferences, e.g. combinedPaymentPreferences, dispatchCutoffTimePreference, itemsAwaitingPaymentPreferences, outOfStockControlPreference. Excluded ship-to locations cannot be changed here (My eBay only). marketplaceId is sent as the required X-EBAY-C-MARKETPLACE-ID header. Returns success (eBay 204 No Content); confirm with ebay_get_user_preferences. Requires sell.account.

marketplaceId.description: eBay marketplace sent as the required X-EBAY-C-MARKETPLACE-ID header, e.g. EBAY_US

preferences.description: Only the preferences to change (PATCH semantics); omitted preferences are left as-is

combinedPaymentPreferences.description: Allow combined invoices for multiple unpaid orders from one buyer

dispatchCutoffTimePreference.description: Order cut-off time for same-day shipping

cutoffTime.description: Same-day shipping cut-off as HH:mm:ss.SSSZ; interpreted in the marketplace default timezone

emailShipmentTrackingNumberPreference.description: Automatically email buyers the tracking number

endOfAuctionEmailPreferences.description: End-of-auction email sent to winning bidders

emailCustomized.description: Send a customized email to winning bidders

logoCustomized.description: Use a customized logo in winning-bidder emails

logoType.description: EndOfAuctionLogoTypeEnum: WINNING_BIDDER_NOTICE, STORE, CUSTOMIZED, or NONE

logoUrl.description: URL of the custom logo image

textCustomized.description: Use customized text in winning-bidder emails

globalShippingProgramListingPreference.description: New eBay UK listings use the Global Shipping Program (seller must be opted in)

autoRelist.description: Relist automatically when cancelled; requires optInStatus true

delayBeforeCancellingCommitment.description: Business days without payment before eBay cancels the line item; required when optInStatus is true

excludedUsers.description: eBay usernames excluded from unpaid item assistance

optInStatus.description: Opt in to (true) or out of unpaid item assistance

removeAllExcludedUsers.description: Clear the excluded users list; do not combine with excludedUsers

outOfStockControlPreference.description: Opt in to Out-of-Stock control (keep sold-out listings alive but hidden)

purchaseReminderEmailPreferences.description: Let eBay send purchase reminder emails for unpaid line items

requiredShipPhoneNumberPreference.description: Require buyers to provide a shipping phone number at checkout

shippingCarrierRatePreferences.description: FedEx/UPS carrier rate types (eBay US only)

name: ebay_set_user_preferences
